messages:
Maya: quick ping — PR #3214 adds a couple of console observability pieces (Grafana panels, tracing hook, and a new prom metric). https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/3214 Can someone take a look? Need approval before EOD for the release tomorrow.
Tom: @Maya I can take a look in ~30m, tagging for visibility :eyes:
Maya: thanks! short summary:
- 2 Grafana panels (P50/P95 latency by route + request rate)
- tracing span added around render path: `console.render`
- new histogram: `console_request_duration_seconds` + counter `console_requests_total` with labels (route, status)
- small dashboard JSON + prom rules

Included query for the latency panel:

```promql
sum(rate(console_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (route)
```

Tom: quick question — did you load the dashboard into staging Grafana and sanity-check panel units? sometimes the buckets are in seconds but panels expect ms.
Maya: yep loaded into staging, screenshot looked fine. I switched panel unit to ms and converted the query with `*1000` in the panel overrides. Also added an alert rule `HighConsoleLatency` (fires when p95 > 500ms for 5m).
Priya: seeing CI failure on metrics registration:
`panic: duplicate metrics collector registration` in `console/metrics.go:42` — looks like package-level collector runs twice in tests. I can push a fix to guard registration with sync.Once or switch to prometheus.RegisterOrGet.
Jorge: will review tracing part. small nit: prefer span name `console.render` (looks like you used `console.render_path` in the diff) — keep consistent with other spans. Also please annotate span with `route` attribute so we can slice traces by route in tracing UI.
Maya: pushed fixes:
- Priya's guard for metrics registration (used `sync.Once`)
- updated span name to `console.render` and added `route` attribute
- adjusted dashboard panel unit to ms
Link updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/3214/files

Tom: left two small review comments: one about dashboard JSON indentation (minor) and one about panel legend formatting. Nothing blocking.

Priya: re-ran CI after my fix — all checks passed :white_check_mark:

Tom: approving now :thumbsup:

ci-bot: staging-validation job queued (job id: 7894)

release-bot: merge blocked: waiting on staging-validation job to complete.

devops-bot: staged deploy window at 23:45 UTC tonight. If this merges before the window we'll pick it up for the next staging run.
Maya: perfect. I'll merge once staging-validation is green and keep an eye on the dashboard metrics after the deploy.

ci-bot: staging-validation job succeeded (job id: 7894) — all checks green.

Tom: last quick note: after merge please watch `console_requests_total{status=~"5.."}` for a few minutes — the alert is noisy if there's a sudden spike from upstream.

release-bot: merged by Maya (commit 9f3b2c2) :shipit:

Maya: merged and rolling monitor on staging. thanks everyone! :party:
